name: NonPlatonic Forms
source:
NonPlatonic Forms is an 18+ Horror Romance Visual Novel about the terribly stubborn Liam Lee, a man who finds himself locked into a desperate game with a dying god. As the embodiment of storytelling, the god would prefer his audience be willing, but his hunger for praise has driven him to the brink. Will the dread deity scoop out Lee's free will, and make the human into a sycophantic member of his eternal audience? Will Lee emerge victorious and slay the god? Or will they, you know...

...kiss?

[From [url=https://alexisroyce.itch.io/nonplatonic-forms-teaser-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
